updates.title: Saved reward protection and coin rewards
changes: Playtime and Battle Pass keep saved item rewards and images when inventory lookups are unavailable.
Add or remove premium coins from trusted server scripts with AddCoins and RemoveCoins exports.
Choose Coins as a Playtime or Battle Pass reward, with the usual earning and premium requirements.
Coin rewards credit the wallet and record the claim together to prevent duplicate awards.
Failed Battle Pass item or vehicle delivery no longer consumes the reward claim.

updates.title: One Inventory compatibility fix
changes: Coin Shop now preserves item products when One Inventory has not finished loading its item definitions, preventing products from being deleted during item validation.
